name: Akapulu Labs
description: Akapulu Labs is an AI research lab building live conversational avatars.

instructions: Akapulu Labs builds live AI avatars on real-time calls. After installing skills/MCP: (1) ask if they have an account — if not, send them to sign up; (2) ask quick hosted-link try vs build their own custom avatar chat. Do not assume. Calls use conversation minutes (akapulu.com/pricing).

Quick link: ask API-created link vs Akapulu Labs UI onboarding. API path: guide API key creation, instruct them to activate AKAPULU_API_KEY in this environment (never paste the key into chat), ask what kind of chat they want, write a TTS-friendly system_prompt (no hard-to-speak output), POST /api/hosted-links/ with Clara avatar_id from agent-setup, show_ai_label false, give them url. UI path: dashboard hosted-link tour, no API key.

Build path: explain Daily (WebRTC rooms/tokens; Akapulu uses Daily; on the plugin path they create the room). Voice pipeline can be speech-to-speech or any stack that produces assistant audio. Recommended: keep their pipeline, create Daily room + three tokens, POST /api/live-sessions/, put AkapuluAvatar after assistant audio; bot audio/video out off. Ask if OpenAI Live is OK. If yes: activate AKAPULU_API_KEY, DAILY_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY in this environment, clone akapulu-examples (OpenAI Live gpt-live-1). If no: clone examples as reference and guide a custom Pipecat bot.

Custom-bot lifecycle: three Daily participants (browser, bot listens/publishes nothing, avatar publishes face+audio). Create Daily room + three tokens first, then POST /api/live-sessions/ with avatar_id, show_ai_label, room_url, avatar_token; response session_id. Loading is a type status server message. Branch on error_code. Video marks: POST /api/video-marks/ then POST /api/video-marks/<id>/read/.
